Match the design language of existing admin screens ({{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}} and {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_4}}): modern corporate SaaS aesthetic (Stripe/Linear/Coursera for Business), slate-50 background, indigo-600 primary (#4F46E5), deep slate-900 sidebar, clean borders, crisp typography (Inter), rounded-xl cards.

Page Layout & Sections:
1. Top Page Header:
   - Title: 'Students & Learners Directory' with count badge '1,248 total' and '• Live Sync' green indicator badge.
   - Subtitle: 'Manage executive learner enrollments, track curriculum completion velocities, and inspect enterprise billing records.'
   - Action bar: Outlined button with download icon 'Export CSV', secondary button 'Bulk Actions', and primary indigo button '+ Manually Enroll Learner'.

2. Top KPI Summary Strip (4 metric cards):
   - Total Learners: 1,248 (+42 this month, positive trend pill)
   - Active Enrollments: 3,540 (Avg 2.8 courses/student)
   - Course Completion Rate: 68.4% (+4.2% vs last quarter)
   - Total Student LTV / Collections: ₹48.20L (Avg order value ₹3,860)

3. Main Content Split View (Students Table with slide-over / pinned Detail Drawer on the right):
   - Left / Main Table Container (flex-1):
     - Table toolbar: Search input ('Search learners by name, email, corporate domain...'), Filter dropdowns ('Status: All Statuses', 'Enrolled Course: All Courses', 'Joined: Last 90 Days'), Sort selector ('Sort: Recently Active').
     - Batch selection strip: '1 Student selected' with quick actions: Send Announcement, Export Selected, Reset Password.
     - High-fidelity Students Table:
       - Columns: Learner (Avatar, Name, Corporate Tag/Domain), Email & Phone, Joined Date, Enrolled Courses (count pill), Overall Progress (visual progress bar with % label), Status Pill (Active - green badge, Suspended - red badge), Actions (kebab icon menu).
       - Row 1 (SELECTED/ACTIVE): Rahul Sharma (Avatar RS in indigo gradient, Pro Learner badge), rahul@gmail.com, Mar 12, 2024, 5 Courses, Progress Bar 68% (Indigo), Status: 'Active' (green pill), kebab menu open/active.
       - Row 2: Samantha Patel (Avatar SP, Deloitte), samantha.p@deloitte.com, Jan 18, 2024, 4 Courses, Progress Bar 82%, Status: 'Active'.
       - Row 3: Rohan Gupta (Avatar RG, McKinsey), rohan.gupta@mckinsey.com, Feb 04, 2024, 3 Courses, Progress Bar 45%, Status: 'Active'.
       - Row 4: Elena Rostova (Avatar ER, Stripe), elena.r@stripe.com, Feb 22, 2024, 2 Courses, Progress Bar 94%, Status: 'Active'.
       - Row 5: Marcus Chen (Avatar MC, CapitalOne), marcus.c@capitalone.com, Nov 15, 2023, 6 Courses, Progress Bar 15%, Status: 'Suspended' (red pill).
       - Pagination footer: Showing 1 to 5 of 1,248 students, rows per page selector, pagination pills (1, 2, 3 ... 25).

   - Right Detail Drawer (pinned slide-over panel, w-96 or 400px wide, high visual polish):
     - Header: Close icon, 'Student Profile', kebab options.
     - Profile Summary: Large avatar (Rahul Sharma), name 'Rahul Sharma', email 'rahul@gmail.com', badge 'Active since Mar 2024', Enterprise seat 'Individual Pro'.
     - Stat chips row:
       - '5' courses enrolled
       - '42' lessons completed
       - '₹14,997' total spent
     - Tab navigation: 'Overview' (active), 'Courses', 'Orders'.
     - Tab Content:
       - Quick info list: Phone +91 98201 44820, Company: Self-sponsored / FinTech, Last login: 14m ago.
       - 'Purchased Courses':
         - Advanced Excel Masterclass: 68% progress bar, 18/26 lessons done.
         - SQL for Modern Data Analysis: 45% progress bar, 14/40 lessons done.
         - Python for Business Analytics: 20% progress bar, 8/38 lessons done.
       - Recent Order History Rows:
         - #ORD-9842 • ₹4,999 • Paid (green badge) • Oct 28
         - #ORD-9710 • ₹4,999 • Paid (green badge) • Aug 14
         - #ORD-9520 • ₹4,999 • Paid (green badge) • Mar 12
       - Drawer Action Buttons Footer:
         - Primary indigo button: 'Manually Enroll Course'
         - Outlined red danger button: 'Revoke Enrollment' / 'Suspend Access'

4. Secondary Section Below (Full-width card): 'Orders & Payments Management'
   - Section Header:
     - Title: 'Orders & Payments' with subtitle 'Live transactional ledger across Razorpay & Stripe corporate gateways.'
     - Search & Status Filter Tabs: Tabs ['All (480)', 'Paid (462)', 'Pending (8)', 'Failed (7)', 'Refunded (3)'].
     - Search bar and date range selector.
   - Orders Table:
     - Columns: Order ID, Learner / Student, Enrolled Masterclass, Amount (INR), Gateway & Ref (Razorpay ID), Status, Timestamp, Actions.
     - Row 1: #ORD-9842 | Rahul Sharma (rahul@gmail.com) | Advanced Excel Masterclass | ₹4,999 | pay_Otz7X92klq | Paid (green pill) | Today, 14:28 | Kebab (Issue Refund, View Receipt)
     - Row 2: #ORD-9841 | Samantha Patel (samantha.p@deloitte.com) | SQL Data Analysis & Warehousing | ₹7,999 | pay_Oty91Bca78 | Paid (green pill) | Today, 11:05 | Kebab

[Retry Link Sent ↻]' | Yesterday, 19:40 | Action button: 'Retry Webhook / Resend Invoice'

     - Row 5: #ORD-9838 | Tanmay Bose (tbose@pwc.in) | Executive BI Dashboard Architecture | ₹5,499 | pay_Otu11Q9421 | Refunded (gray/amber pill) | Oct 27, 2024 | Action: 'Refund Settled'
